↪ Fetch proxy

…

The counterpoint to github-stars: instead of calling the GitHub API directly (and tripping CSP), this app routes it through the platform's fetch-proxy — audited, metered, and (when a connection secret is bound) with the credential injected server-side. The app bundle never holds a token.

1 · Explicit proxy /rate_limit

fetch('/_api/fetch/https://api.github.com/rate_limit') — same-origin, so no CSP exception. Keyless shows limit 60; with a bound secret it jumps to 5000.

…

2 · Explicit proxy /user (injection proof)

/_api/fetch/https://api.github.com/user — an auth-only endpoint. The app sends no Authorization header; 401 until a github connection secret is bound, then it returns your account.

…

3 · Shim · native fetch()

fetch('https://api.github.com/rate_limit') — an absolute URL, no proxy path. CSP-blocked unless the transparent shim is on, which rewrites it to the proxy with no code change.

…

4 · Shim · XMLHttpRequest (axios)

A raw XMLHttpRequest to the absolute URL — the transport axios uses by default. The shim patches XHR.open too, so this rides the same rewrite.
